# HomeBank's own example file

`example.xhb` is the sample file distributed with HomeBank (path `data/datas/example.xhb`
in the source tarball `homebank-5.10.3.tar.gz` from https://www.gethomebank.org).
It was written by HomeBank 5.1 (`v="1.3" d="050100"`).

It is used as an independent check that the reader and the HomeBank-style serialiser
match what HomeBank really writes. It contains only fictional sample data.
